items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Chani come up to my house and say come on play with me... I'd grab my drums... and I played that ball and I played to the whole band

ctx.x: Oh, I said, I can play but I don't look.

I used to tell you. He said, let me. But it ain't nothing. So I said, well, all right. I'll play. And finally, like he said, Ornice. For pumped. For Tony Hanzo now. You know, he had to be operated here when the drum hit him constantly.
On his left leg it hit constantly.
